text:
maria: Quick async — GPU provisioning / capacity sync for APAC + EU.

maria: What I did: filed quota requests to GCP (ap-northeast1, europe-west4), spun up a temporary us-central buffer pool, and opened ticket with cloud for 4 spare NV6s.

maria: Blockers: GCP quota team is slow (ticket 12345678), and the v520 driver image is causing sporadic pod evictions on a subset of nodes.

akash: Got those ticket IDs? Can you share and I'll escalate with our partner contact? Also we should ensure AZ spread so we don't lose an entire region if a zone is degraded.

maria: Ticket IDs: GCP-12345678 (quota), CLOUD-9876 (NV6 request). Added a note to require multi-AZ. Thanks @akash.

jess: FYI reserved capacity pool usage at 78% overall. If quota delays persist we should enable burst autoscaling for the eu-west4-pool (policy: burst=+20% for 30m).

infra-bot: [metric alert] eu-west4-pool GPU util > 75% for 15m — triggered at 1769994200.

sam: On fallback plans: we should ensure routing policy favors t4 variants when NV6 not available. Added a canary route in staging, can promote to prod if tests pass.

li: Quick ops note — there's a taint blocking scale-up on the ap-northeast1 nodes: run
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep tainted
kubectl taint nodes <node> gpu-maintenance:NoSchedule-
```
That unblocks the autoscaler for new node creation.

maria: Plan for today: 1) follow up with GCP escalations (ping @akash), 2) try a controlled reimage of a subset with the fallback driver, 3) enable short burst on eu pool if quota not in time. Will update here in the afternoon. :thumbsup:
